description.narrative: The program will provide budget support during the country's fiscal consolidation process for reforms to (i) improve fiscal policy management, and (ii) develop policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs. Through these reforms, the program will help sustain financing for social welfare programs.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 2. Policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs improved Indicator: 2a. Total poverty-targeted transfers to poorest households increased in 2015 by 60% (2014 baseline: MNT10 billion) Data Source: 2a. Annual Budget Report Actual value:

Output: 1. Fiscal policy management improved Indicator: 1a.Parliament approves the CMAP by October 2015 Data Source: 1a. CMAP Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Fiscal policy management improved Indicator: 1b. The government makes the Budget Transparency Law effective by October 2015 Data Source: 1b. Budget Transparency Law Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Fiscal policy management improved Indicator: 1c. The Parliament approves the amended FSL to (i) include budgetary expenditures financed by the Development Bank of Mongolia under the State budget; and (ii) to reflect a gradual reduction of fiscal deficit and debt levels to the original targets of the Law by 2018 (2% and 40% of gross domestic product, respectively), by October 2015 Data Source: 1c. Amended FSL Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Fiscal policy management improved Indicator: 1d. The government terminates the Price Stabilization Program and transfers the outstanding loans from the central bank to the State budget to be subject to the Fiscal Stability Law by October 2015 Data Source: 1d. Government decree on the program's termination Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Fiscal policy management improved Indicator: 1e. The government submits to Parliament the second budget amendment to the 2015 budget to adjust fiscal expenditure ensuring that funding for social welfare programs is maintained, by December 2015 Data Source: 1e. Amended budget Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 2. Policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs improved Indicator: 2b.Parliament approves the Revised Citizens' Health Insurance Law to subsidize health insurance contributions for household members in need of social welfare services, by October 2015. Data Source: 2b. Revised Citizen's Health Insurance law Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 2. Policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs improved Indicator: 2c. The Cabinet issues a decree to use the poverty-targeted Integrated Household Information Database across government programs by October 2015. Data Source: 2c. Draft Cabinet decree Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 2. Policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs improved Indicator: 2d. The government allocates funding under the 2015 MPDSP budget to maintain and update the Integrated Household Information Database, including capacity to disaggregated data by sex, to capture the new poor and improve targeting by October 2015. Data Source: 2d. MPDSP budget Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 2. Policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs improved Indicator: 2e. The Government through the MPDSP issues a ministerial order requiring the Health Insurance Organization to ensure health insurance coverage for household members in need of social welfare services by June 2016. Data Source: 2e. MPDSP ministerial decree Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y

Output: 2. Policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs improved Indicator: 2f. The government prepares a draft resolution for at least two ministries to use proxy-means testing in selected programs by June 2016. Data Source: 2f. Draft government resolution Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y

Output: 2. Policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs improved Indicator: 2g. The Prime Minister establishes an inter-ministerial working group to analyze options and impacts (including gender analysis) to prepare a plan to further consolidate social welfare programs of the MPDSP. Data Source: 2g. Prime Minister's order Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: 2. Policies and regulations to support targeting and consolidation of social welfare programs improved Indicator: 2h. The government strengthens monitoring and evaluation of social welfare programs by ensuring budget allocations for the quarterly preparation of the 2016 household socioeconomic survey by December 2015. Data Source: 2h. Annual budget report Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y
Social welfare expenditure maintained in 2015 at MNT285 billion Data Source: Annual Budget Report Base year: 2014 Baseline value: N
